newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S 15-KM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S 15-KM WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Tuesday's men's 15-km freestyle pursuit cross-country race at the Nordic skiing world championhips.
Previous world titles: seven (15-km and relay in 1991 in Val di
Fiemme, Italy; 30-km, 15-km pursuit and relay in 1993 in Falun,
Sweden; relay in 1995 in Thunder Bay, Canada; 10-km in 1997 in
Other facts. The most successful cross-country skier of all
time, Daehlie had entered the Trondheim world championships with
five Olympic titles and a record 33 World Cup wins.
